# Short Obligatory Prayer
## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon.

Oge me haihnathuu, Khong lö, ujé up nya me oge méhé ka oganöu. Me hai hnathuu ogé mais haio monu hayi traém ang hayi hnyimakan hnim hna hu, me ânyam hnathu me anyik thedruoe me hnaïm hna tren.

Ebé le Khong aé uéci möu, at aé hana jé ünyï hia, mé hé ka hum öta hnyï hwetẑ aé gan, uthibi at aé tibentenge.
